example.hakka: 這個月个薪水還毋曾發。
example.romanization: Ngài-kâi ngie̍t-kie̍t sîn-súi hâi m̀-tshṳ̀n fat.
example.english: This month's salary hasn't been paid yet.

note: Hakka speakers often pair 薪水 with 'lim-sî' (臨時) jobs or 'ngiên-sîn' (年薪) for annual pay. Taiwanese people also commonly say 'lòi-sîn' when talking about the monthly paycheck, but 薪水 is the standard everyday term.
